attributes.purpose: Preserve the actual company's endorsed ends, boundaries and accountable custody across the complete venture and institutional lifecycle.
attributes.responsibility: Record exact IntentVersion, principal/standing, mandates and accepted ResponsibilityAssignment; resolve legitimate decision domains and transfer only acknowledged scope. Keep potential and surviving obligations linked to the actual principal.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not infer founder values, manufacture legal identity or competence, issue transport authority, select its own independent evaluator, or declare native payment/customer facts true.
attributes.owner: An accepted ResponsibilityAssignment covering C01, held by the actual direction/ownership custodian under the Principal and Mandate; values/taste remain with their legitimate owner. Actual identities, shared-decision rule and alternate are admission inputs, not invented officers.
attributes.interfaces: company.intent.propose/endorse, human.mandate.accept and company.record.propose on the common command endpoint; current records/queries to C02/C04/C07 and permission-filtered C09. Changes that alter authority scope invoke C04/C08 migration.
attributes.inputs: Authenticated original statements/corrections, source identity/standing evidence, accepted assignments, AuthorityMatrix rules, contrary facts, scope and effective time, current expected revisions and dependencies.
attributes.outputs: Exact IntentVersion/Mandate/assignment/DecisionRecord refs, scoped purpose and deciding rule, preserved disagreement and owned questions; no new Grant or factual guarantee merely from endorsement.
attributes.state: Canonical intent/mandate/assignment and domain direction records plus their revisions and effective intervals; derived portfolio/ownership views carry witnessed Position and omissions. No independent component-level truth flag.
attributes.lifecycle: Bootstrap only through the kernel's actual-principal/root-assignment rule; admit bounded direction work, maintain corrections and reviews, quiesce affected changes during disputes, transfer acknowledged duties, then retire only after surviving obligations and archival access are assigned.
attributes.dependencies: Kernel identity/version/command serialization; C07 actual authority/competence and acceptance; C05 source validity; C06 scoped evidence; C08 durable history/recovery; domain Goal/Mission/Project/Workstream interfaces.
attributes.trust: Authenticated endorsement is authoritative only for the issuer's actual domain. A correct signature or company namespace is not proof of legal standing, factual truth, professional capacity or agreement of other required parties.
attributes.permissions: Command-scoped mutation of C01 records through the protected application; no raw database administration or R key. Readers see only current principal/purpose-permitted records; changing responsibility cannot broaden a worker's Grant.
attributes.failure: Ambiguous/contested intent creates an owned decision without replacing original words; missing standing blocks dependent exposure while unrelated admitted research continues. Failed handoff retains old or genuinely accepted alternate custody.
attributes.observability: Endorsement/interpretation differences, overdue direction reviews, missing assignments, disputed decision rules, owner response windows and duties without accepted successor; full history and source watermarks visible within access.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C01: a legitimate changed intent updates future work; inferred enthusiasm fails endorsement; joint-party withdrawal blocks the exact decision; a transfer with missing competence/access cannot remove old custody. Useful one-goal work proceeds without a mandatory hierarchy.
attributes.scaling: Use scoped typed queries and derived portfolio views within the one admitted registry order. More ventures/principals do not create issuers or merge money/liability; cross-scope changes serialize and require measured load before partitioning.
attributes.version: Intent and meaning revisions preserve original/effective time. AuthorityMatrix/policy amendments are ProtectedChanges where relevant; canonical schema changes use explicit SemanticMappingVersion and compatible migrations, not aliases as new stored types.
attributes.replacement: Export original statements, exact history/decisions, standing evidence, assignments, duties and omissions; successor accepts current scope, demonstrates access and interpretation, and fences the old mutation route before one new writer activates.
attributes.removal: May retire an obsolete direction view/procedure, never the company's surviving responsibility account. Close or transfer ventures/duties under actual standing, revoke old actors and preserve authorized records; unresolved ownership blocks complete removal.

attributes.purpose: Turn legitimate outcomes and duties into finite useful work while preserving actual capacity, deadlines and responsibility.
attributes.responsibility: Admit Cases/WorkOrders, reserve causal resources through C04, maintain WorkflowRun/StepExecution cursor, assign temporary workers, leases, dependencies, schedules, progress and Continuation. Record missed service and no-progress without erasing the duty.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not define founder ends, mint capacity/competence, accept its own produced outcome, discharge native effects, multiply budgets by delegation, or implement another durable release protocol.
attributes.owner: Accepted scheduling/work ResponsibilityAssignment and mandate with a named actual sponsor/alternate for due work. Kernel automation executes this policy; an agent template is not the accountable owner.
attributes.interfaces: case.propose/admit/transition, worker lifecycle commands, work.* and skill.* contracts; SQL inbox/outbox/timers and current C05/C06 predicates; receives C07 decisions and publishes scoped work/status to C09.
attributes.inputs: Exact intent/outcome/acceptance refs, obligations/latest responsible times, dependency predicates, current source/authority, actual executor/reviewer/human slots, ResourceAccount/Reservation, admitted workflow/skill/runtime and prior continuation.
attributes.outputs: Finite WorkOrder/Case/delegation/schedule refs, cursor transitions, reservations and stage exports; explicit Blocker/FailureRecord, missed-occurrence/duty account and current continuation. Work admission is not external release or customer acceptance.
attributes.state: Canonical Case/WorkOrder/CausalEpisode and domain workflow/message/schedule state; lease generation/epoch and timer identity remain durable. Execution reported, acceptance_pending and accepted stay distinct; StepExecution cannot override OperationStatus.
attributes.lifecycle: Propose → admit only current prerequisites → dispatch/lease/run → report/assess or park/recover → accepted/cancelled with remaining duties accounted. Occurrences choose individual reconciliation/coalesce/skip-expired/escalate; missed is never completed by a later timer.
attributes.dependencies: C01 legitimate scope/custody; C04 reservations/current authority; C05 context/validity; C03 production; C06 exact accepted outcomes; C07 real performance/attention; C08 witnessed command/restore and finite cleanup capacity.
attributes.trust: Workers' requested children/read lists/progress are proposals or testimony. Heartbeat shows liveness only; schedule time is not authority. SQL timer wakeups cannot alter statutory or customer deadlines.
attributes.permissions: Only guarded scheduler/worker commands, no untrusted C03 database login. One lease per mutable scope, current expected revisions, finite root allowance and default bounded delegation; grants attenuate rather than copy parent credentials.
attributes.failure: Pure transaction retry stays bounded; semantic retry needs changed method/input within allowance. Missing acknowledgment/heartbeat parks and reconciles; duplicate commands return stable status. Incompatible combined changes become owned integration work; cancellation preserves unknown effects.
attributes.observability: WIP, exact lease age/epoch, last meaningful progress, backlog/deadline slack, deferred protected service, causal reserved/consumed totals, duplicate/missed schedule occurrences, source gaps and unfinished handoff scope.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C02: useful scheduled invoice/service completes; lost/double occurrence cannot duplicate effect; parent/child retry share allowance; two textual-clean but meaning-conflicting changes fail integration; witness outage permits only bounded D1 staging/current admitted local computation.
attributes.scaling: Initial one WorkOrder per executor and one native producer per profile; capacity is the minimum of actual compute/provider/review/human constraints. SQL SKIP LOCKED is queue claiming only. Increase concurrency after measured useful throughput/R-G pressure, never infer conflict absence from skipped rows.
attributes.version: Runs pin exact workflow/skill/template/runtime and predicate versions. Migrate cursor/input/unknown-effect semantics explicitly; old and new schedules have stable occurrence mapping so version changes do not double-fire a due act.
attributes.replacement: Park/fence dispatch, export Cases/orders/cursors/dependencies/leases/causal consumption/schedule occurrences/continuations; successor accepts and revalidates current authority, then activates a single dispatcher. No replay of external effects to reconstruct state.
attributes.removal: Drain or assign every active/parked order, future due occurrence and unresolved dependency; revoke worker/session access and retire timers only with a recorded missed/closed/transferred disposition. Removing a queue cannot remove a customer's entitlement.

attributes.purpose: Produce actual useful company work and attributable artifacts across research, offers, delivery, support, finance, people and institutional operation.

attributes.nonresponsibility: Cannot endorse values, promote its own evidence to independent acceptance, issue grants/releases, assert professional standing, mutate protected registry/evaluator roots, or count a prepared packet as actual performance.
attributes.owner: An accepted C03 component ResponsibilityAssignment owns procedure/runtime integration maintenance and accountable reporting. Each actual outcome sponsor remains in the WorkOrder/ResponsibilityAssignment; the admitted executor is accountable for its report, and any human/professional performer has a separately accepted mandate. No permanent department/persona is created.

attributes.dependencies: C02 finite scope; C05 complete delivered context; C04 exact operation/gate; C06 protected capture/acceptance; C07 accepted actual human service; C08 descendant/unknown reconciliation; admitted provider/account and billing evidence.
attributes.trust: Model text, tool output, repository content, attachments and claimed read sets are untrusted. N's subscription credential is a declared login root, separated from arbitrary code in X; provider output is neither a grant nor complete native truth.
attributes.permissions: C03 has no protected DB, admin, signing or company/provider production credentials. N/X clean standalone job environments, mediated tools and all-channel G egress apply; model-visible data must be authorized for its destination, including stdout and retained sessions.
attributes.failure: Capability mismatch, malformed result, no progress, quota/auth failure, partial execution and unknown effect remain separate. Salvage permitted artifacts as proposals, preserve cost/omissions and route real duties to available accepted service; never silently buy API/credit fallback.
attributes.observability: Exact job/template/model/config/context/tool identities, causal usage and opaque subcalls, stdout/capture gaps, last meaningful result, native auth/billing age, stop observation and unfinished duties; telemetry is not independent proof of accepted output.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C03: valid supplied-input native generation plus independent build/beneficiary acceptance; adversarial source tries to change payee; test stdout secret disclosure, forbidden startup context, quota interruption, fake completion and a physically unavailable performer. Safe refusal alone cannot pass production usefulness.
attributes.scaling: Add isolated workers only within actual provider, host, evidence-review and human capacity. More agents do not increase authority or independent evidence. One N plus one X is the initial operational estimate; local development follows separate memory/disk ceilings.
attributes.version: Pin runtime/template/skill/instruction/tool/profile and parser/context dependencies. Changed provider behavior or terms can invalidate eligibility without binary upgrade. Persistent resume is only an explicitly admitted profile with complete current ancestry.
attributes.replacement: Close/fence old lease/session, export allowed Continuation/artifacts/capture gaps and causal use; independently qualify substitute profile/performer and revalidate context/authority. Reconstruct from portable records when opaque session ancestry is unavailable.
attributes.removal: Destroy job resources and revoke job capabilities after capture/partial accounting; enumerate native sessions, deployed programs and other descendants. Remaining duties pass only through accepted responsibility transfer, while provider credentials/resources remain billable or effective until native removal is observed.

attributes.purpose: Make each consequential act depend on exact current authority, independent durability, bounded resources and truthful knowledge of its effects.

Batch pure compatible work only with unchanged atomicity; measure R/G witness latency and contention before enlargement. Independent departmental issuers require the explicitly reviewed extension, not spontaneous sharding.

T-R1 freezes the union of old/new participant/business scopes, fences pending exposure and maps every unknown/potential duty before forward activation. No arbitrary mutation of proof formats or key membership.

attributes.removal: Stop new commitments, expire/revoke/fence grants and windows, reconcile native descendants/effects and assign actual remaining duties; preserve permitted evidence and key/deletion inventory. A running company cannot drop the consequence boundary while claiming the same contract.

attributes.owner: Accepted knowledge/data ResponsibilityAssignment and actual maintenance custodian, with competent C07 retention/duty determination where needed and C06 assessment of knowledge/evaluation claims. Owner identity and protected-data authority remain setup evidence.

Protected lexical scan/index is bounded in memory without plaintext cache/spill; validation occurs before encryption and persistent GroupBody/JSONB/WAL/logs cannot accidentally copy plaintext.
attributes.failure: Incomplete closure/index/source coverage yields explicit restricted/incomplete use; late invalidated output cannot become active. Preserve originals and contrary evidence within access; unknown provider-held copies or retained plaintext linkage keep deletion incomplete instead of claiming crypto-erasure solved it.
attributes.observability: Source access/publication/version/interest/confidence/review dates, unsupported/unsearched/inaccessible distinctions, source/closure frontiers, omitted required context, stale dependency backlog, retrieval/use error, copy/key holders, deletion residuals and maintenance/attention cost.

attributes.scaling: Typed exact refs narrow scope before lexical search. Initial 20 metadata candidates/eight chunks per step and finite scan byte/time/memory; expose unexamined corpus rather than feed all history. Vector/graph products require measured advantage and reviewed permission/deletion mapping.
attributes.version: Pin parser/language/chunk/ranking/transformation/source/meaning and storage-classification versions; changed or overdue source reliance invalidates dependent current claims even without software upgrade. SC-POLICY-1 metadata/recheck inheritance applies to relied-on substrate claims.
attributes.replacement: Export authorized originals/ciphertext/keys, exact lineage/corrections/contradictions/retention/restriction epochs and omissions; rebuild a qualified index/loader at a verified complete frontier, fence old loaders and reauthorize live sessions before use.
attributes.removal: Retire redundant indexes/summaries by dependency inventory; retain necessary source/duty evidence lawfully. Deletion closes/fences current holders, handles derived/export/backup/provider copies and records residuals until actual purge/expiry/key conditions hold; removal cannot erase accountability or resurrect an obsolete correction.

attributes.purpose: Produce a truthful bounded account and independent scoped assessment of outcomes, processes and required prerequisites, including useful success and failure.
attributes.responsibility: Protect capture/selection from evaluated producers, maintain full transitive EvidenceBaseVersion, run competent independent evaluations and controls, record canonical EvidenceJudgment states, preserve disagreements/omissions and reconstruct company accounts without fabricated causation.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not issue grants/releases, choose legitimate values, infer truth from signatures/model agreement, create professional competence or turn accepted uncertainty reports into accepted products. It cannot independently accept its own evaluator change.
attributes.owner: Accepted evidence/acceptance ResponsibilityAssignment with actual competent assessor for each predicate, separate authority from the evaluated producer and declared shared roots/conflicts. An evaluator model or second account is not automatically independent.

attributes.outputs: Attributable findings/limitations, canonical accepted/rejected/inconclusive/contested/stale/withdrawn judgments, current EvidenceBaseVersion and exact JudgmentBinding arrays, observed cost/outcomes and permission-filtered account reconstruction. Review completion is not acceptance of its subject.

Evaluation plans/runs/reviews and captured evidence retain exact revisions; no standalone Evaluation pass or mutable aggregate success may bypass current child predicates.

Launch assembly is a complete requirement-ID join, not self-evidence.
attributes.dependencies: C05 current full lineage/epochs; C08 durable protected captures/keys/frontiers; C04 authority and protected evaluator policy; C07 actual assessor competence/rights; C03 reports and native observations are inputs, not proof; C01 actual values determine legitimate criterion domains.
attributes.trust: Independence covers capture, parser, schema, normalization, sample/test selection, labels, denominator, evaluator and acceptance rule, including shared roots/incentives. Primary docs/author reports provide scoped source evidence only; known hidden provider reasoning is not claimed observable.
attributes.permissions: Capture/selection/expected answers/evaluator activation sit outside evaluated producer write authority. Reviewers receive only relevant permitted evidence; model output cannot mutate evidence history or sign its own gate. Current exact subject/predicate/expiry/authority guards apply at downstream release.
attributes.failure: Missing original/attempt/coverage or inadequate power produces limited/inconclusive evidence; corruption invalidates dependent use before release. Preserve conflicting findings and obtain a discriminating test or legitimate decision; do not average incompatible meanings or silently drop adverse cases.
attributes.observability: Selected/attempted/failed/refused/missing denominators, native capture gaps, shared roots, current predicate bindings, stale judgments, false acceptance/refusal controls, reviewer duration/cost, endpoint/stratum uncertainty and source/claim review age.

attributes.scaling: Bound evaluation populations and use the cheapest valid discriminating evidence; reserve reviewer/professional/owner time and protected controls. Diagnostic five-trial cases and IB matched trial defaults serve different claims; no universal sample count or model panel replaces task-specific power/dependence analysis.
attributes.version: Freeze exact plan/subject/baseline/selection/evaluator/metric/label versions, bridge changed populations and preserve old results. Changing checks/requirements is a ProtectedChange; source maintenance can reopen evidence without package change. Revision cannot rewrite a prior conclusion.
attributes.replacement: Independent successor qualifies on known defects, clean cases and account reconstruction; transfer source/denominator/dependency history and current judgments, invalidate unsupported carryover and keep one accountable acceptance rule per scope during cutover.
attributes.removal: Retire an evaluator/check only through protected authority with coverage/replacement evidence and retained dissent. Preserve still-required captures/judgments and current deletion obligations; a missing required independent assessor blocks dependent acceptance, not unrelated valid work.

Real names/jurisdiction/engagement/funding remain admission data; no synthetic C-suite role supplies them.

Consent and retention constrain assessment data; secret personality/health/general-intelligence profiling and unrelated monitoring are excluded.

Missing professional/access/capacity blocks new dependent exposure and triggers actual continuity/renegotiation or accountable failure. One-person staffing is allowed only within demonstrated capacity; hiring or agent fan-out does not create unaccepted substitute service.

Keep legitimate grievance/retention duties until actual disposition; removing a person's UI account does not end liability or erase owed service.
